CustomField.description: Apex class implementing TriggerHandler.ErrorLogger, TriggerHandler.OperationLogger, or both. Only read from the GLOBAL record. Leave blank to write to the debug log.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Apex class implementing TriggerHandler.ErrorLogger and/or TriggerHandler.OperationLogger, e.g. NebulaTriggerLogger. Only read from the GLOBAL record.
CustomField.label: Logger
